document.title: Run CLI tests, lint and format check in CI; production builds by default
document.summary: CI and `agent-check fast` now run `test:cli`, `lint` and `format:check`. `vitadeck build` produces production bundles unless `--dev` is passed. `pnpm build` is the single production build that CMake, CI and agent-check share.
document.why: The only JS test, `lint` and `format:check` ran nowhere, shipped `.vdapp`s ran React in dev mode on the Vita, and the embedded runtime's mode depended on which build script ran last ([#57](source:s1)).

sources.title: CI gaps: run test:cli, lint, format:check; make build mode explicit
sources.gist: Add the missing JS checks to CI and agent-check fast, default author builds to production with --dev, use one build mode in CMake, align reconciler types.

sources.label: PR #63
sources.gist: Implements #57 items 1-3; leaves reconciler types at 0.28.9.

lookFor: Not done: [#57](source:s1) asks to align `@types/react-reconciler` with `react-reconciler` 0.29, but the catalog keeps 0.28.9. No 0.29 types are published; 0.28.x is the newest line for the React 18 reconciler, and 0.31+ type the React 19 reconciler.

groups.title: JS checks in CI and agent-check fast
groups.summary: The CI `build` job and `run_fast` in `scripts/agent-check.sh` call the same three `pnpm --dir js` scripts, and the new root `test:cli` script forwards to `@vitadeck/sdk`.
lookFor: Subtle: root `lint` and `lint:fix` now run `examples/chat/scripts/ensure-genesys-local.mjs` first, which copies `genesys.local.example.ts` to the gitignored `genesys.local.ts` when it is missing; without it, `lint` fails on a fresh checkout with no-unsafe-* errors in `examples/chat`.

groups.title: `vitadeck build` defaults to production, `--dev` opts out
groups.why: Author builds defaulted to `NODE_ENV=development`, so shipped `.vdapp`s ran React dev mode on the Vita ([#57](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `main` in `cli.ts` accepts `--dev` and passes it as `BuildOptions.dev`, which picks the `process.env.NODE_ENV` define; the new tests build a fixture in both modes and check the inlined string.
lookFor: Breaking: the CLI no longer reads `NODE_ENV` from the environment, so an author running `NODE_ENV=development vitadeck build` now gets a production bundle; only `--dev` gives development.

groups.title: One production build for the embedded runtime
groups.why: CMake used `build:prod` while CI and agent-check used `build`, so the runtime in the native build depended on which ran last ([#57](source:s1)).
groups.summary: The runtime `rolldown.config.js` defaults to production, so `build:prod` is deleted and CMake's `js_build` and `js` targets call `pnpm build` like CI and agent-check.
lookFor: `pnpm --dir js build` now emits a minified production `runtime.js`; any `NODE_ENV` other than `development` (including unset or `test`) yields production, and `NODE_ENV=development pnpm --dir js build` is the only way to get the dev runtime.
